title: Joy to the Earth! the Prince of Peace
description: Joy to the Earth! the Prince of Peace in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 809 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Gospel of Peace”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Joy to the earth! the Prince of Peace His ban-ner has un-furled; Let strife, and sin, and er-ror cease, And joy per-vade the world!

lines: Joy to the earth! the Prince of Peace
Let strife, and sin, and error cease,
Praise ye the Lord! for truth and grace
Let every soul his love embrace,
Peace on the earth, good will to men,
Let that sweet strain be heard again,
Joy to the isles and lands afar,
Let every eye behold the star,
The star of light and love.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
